potato.title: Potato mode
potato.off: Your own graphics settings are active.
potato.effects: Clouds, entity shadows, smooth lighting, mipmaps and biome blending are disabled. Fabulous graphics uses Fancy instead.
potato.preserved: View distance, transparent leaves, players, ships, projectiles, particles, animation, sound and controls keep your settings.
potato.reversible: Your preferences are preserved. Switch off this mode or remove the addon to use them again.
potato.error: Could not apply the change. See the game log.
